const EMBEDDED_IMAGES = {"assets/game1-left.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","assets/game1-right.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","assets/game2-left.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","assets/game2-right.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","assets/game3-left.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","assets/game3-right.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","assets/game4-left.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","assets/game4-right.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,"};

const $ = selector => document.querySelector(selector);
const state = { level: 0, found: new Set(), hints: 3, startedAt: null, elapsed: 0, timerId: null };

function imageSource(path) {
  return EMBEDDED_IMAGES[path] || path;
}

function formatTime(seconds) {
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60).toString().padStart(2, "0");
  const rest = (seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, "0");
  return `${minutes}:${rest}`;
}

function startTimer() {
  if (state.startedAt) return;
  state.startedAt = Date.now() - state.elapsed * 1000;
  state.timerId = setInterval(() => {
    state.elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - state.startedAt) / 1000);
    $("#timer").textContent = formatTime(state.elapsed);
  }, 250);
}

function stopTimer() {
  clearInterval(state.timerId);
  state.timerId = null;
}

function renderDots() {
  $("#levelDots").innerHTML = games.map((_, index) =>
    `<span class="level-dot ${index < state.level ? "done" : ""} ${index === state.level ? "active" : ""}"></span>`
  ).join("");
}

function markerHTML(spot, side, index, extraClass = "") {
  const [x, y, radius] = spot[side];
  return `<span class="marker ${extraClass}" data-index="${index}" style="--x:${x}%;--y:${y}%;--size:${radius * 2}%"></span>`;
}

function renderMarkers() {
  const game = games[state.level];
  for (const side of ["left", "right"]) {
    $(`#${side}Markers`).innerHTML = [...state.found]
      .map(index => markerHTML(game.spots[index], side, index))
      .join("");
  }
  $("#foundCount").textContent = state.found.size;
}

function loadLevel() {
  const game = games[state.level];
  state.found.clear();
  $("#levelLabel").textContent = `Level ${state.level + 1} of ${games.length}`;
  $("#levelTitle").textContent = game.title;
  $("#leftImage").src = imageSource(game.left);
  $("#rightImage").src = imageSource(game.right);
  $("#message").textContent = "Look closely and start searching!";
  $("#message").className = "message";
  $("#nextButton").disabled = true;
  $("#nextButton").textContent = state.level === games.length - 1 ? "Reveal My Reward" : "Next Level";
  renderDots();
  renderMarkers();
}

function handlePictureClick(event) {
  startTimer();
  const stage = event.currentTarget;
  const side = stage.closest(".picture").dataset.side;
  const rect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width * 100;
  const y = (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height * 100;
  const game = games[state.level];

  const hit = game.spots.findIndex((spot, index) => {
    if (state.found.has(index)) return false;
    const [sx, sy, radius] = spot[side];
    const dx = x - sx;
    const dy = (y - sy) * (rect.height / rect.width);
    return Math.hypot(dx, dy) <= radius;
  });

  if (hit >= 0) {
    state.found.add(hit);
    renderMarkers();
    $("#message").textContent = `Great find! ${5 - state.found.size} left.`;
    if (state.found.size === 5) {
      $("#message").textContent = "Excellent! You found all 5 differences.";
      $("#message").classList.add("success");
      $("#nextButton").disabled = false;
    }
  } else {
    const wrong = document.createElement("span");
    wrong.className = "wrong";
    wrong.textContent = "×";
    wrong.style.setProperty("--x", `${x}%`);
    wrong.style.setProperty("--y", `${y}%`);
    stage.appendChild(wrong);
    setTimeout(() => wrong.remove(), 600);
    $("#message").textContent = "No difference there. Try another spot.";
  }
}

function useHint() {
  if (!state.hints) {
    $("#message").textContent = "You have used all your hints.";
    return;
  }
  const index = games[state.level].spots.findIndex((_, i) => !state.found.has(i));
  if (index < 0) return;
  startTimer();
  state.hints -= 1;
  $("#hintCount").textContent = state.hints;
  const spot = games[state.level].spots[index];
  const hint = document.createElement("span");
  hint.className = "marker hint-pulse";
  const [x, y, radius] = spot.right;
  hint.style.cssText = `--x:${x}%;--y:${y}%;--size:${radius * 2}%`;
  $("#rightMarkers").appendChild(hint);
  setTimeout(() => hint.remove(), 2100);
  $("#message").textContent = "Hint: watch the flashing area in the right picture.";
}

function resetGame() {
  stopTimer();
  state.level = 0;
  state.elapsed = 0;
  state.startedAt = null;
  state.hints = 3;
  $("#timer").textContent = "00:00";
  $("#hintCount").textContent = state.hints;
  $("#celebration").hidden = true;
  $("#couponReward").hidden = true;
  $("#revealCouponButton").hidden = false;
  $("#playAgainButton").hidden = true;
  $("#copyCouponButton").textContent = "Copy Code";
  $("#confetti").innerHTML = "";
  loadLevel();
}

function nextLevel() {
  if (state.found.size < 5) return;
  if (state.level < games.length - 1) {
    state.level += 1;
    loadLevel();
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  } else {
    stopTimer();
    $("#finalTime").textContent = formatTime(state.elapsed);
    $("#celebration").hidden = false;
  }
}

function revealCoupon() {
  $("#couponReward").hidden = false;
  $("#revealCouponButton").hidden = true;
  $("#playAgainButton").hidden = false;
  launchConfetti();
}

function launchConfetti() {
  const colors = ["#ff7a1a", "#ffd85a", "#ff3d45", "#9f6dff", "#ffffff"];
  const container = $("#confetti");
  container.innerHTML = "";
  for (let index = 0; index < 42; index += 1) {
    const piece = document.createElement("span");
    piece.className = "confetti-piece";
    piece.style.cssText = [
      `--left:${Math.random() * 100}%`,
      `--width:${6 + Math.random() * 7}px`,
      `--height:${10 + Math.random() * 10}px`,
      `--color:${colors[index % colors.length]}`,
      `--rotate:${Math.random() * 360}deg`,
      `--drift:${-90 + Math.random() * 180}px`,
      `--duration:${2.2 + Math.random() * 1.8}s`,
      `--delay:${Math.random() * .45}s`
    ].join(";");
    container.appendChild(piece);
  }
  setTimeout(() => { container.innerHTML = ""; }, 4700);
}

async function copyCoupon() {
  const code = $("#couponCode").textContent.trim();
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
  } catch (_) {
    const input = document.createElement("textarea");
    input.value = code;
    input.style.position = "fixed";
    input.style.opacity = "0";
    document.body.appendChild(input);
    input.select();
    document.execCommand("copy");
    input.remove();
  }
  $("#copyCouponButton").textContent = "Copied!";
}

document.querySelectorAll(".image-stage").forEach(stage => stage.addEventListener("click", handlePictureClick));
$("#hintButton").addEventListener("click", useHint);
$("#resetButton").addEventListener("click", resetGame);
$("#nextButton").addEventListener("click", nextLevel);
$("#revealCouponButton").addEventListener("click", revealCoupon);
$("#copyCouponButton").addEventListener("click", copyCoupon);
$("#playAgainButton").addEventListener("click", resetGame);

loadLevel();
